direction: Football documentary narrator who slowly realises the subject is not football. Serious and cinematic in the hook, brisk and commercial through the transfer market, warm and playful in pre-season, colder and more savage as the season turns, then a deadpan comedic landing on the final reveal.

segments.text: Ronaldo has retired from international football...
But some men are still playing in three different leagues.
In the relationship transfer market, some players don't scout one club. They send DMs to five, negotiate with three, and sign nowhere exclusively.
First comes scouting. That's the talking stage. Then the signing ceremony. Suddenly, you're officially his number one striker.
Then comes pre-season. Training sessions. Friendly matches. Chemistry building. Everybody is suddenly playing like they're chasing the Ballon d'Or.
But after the first major trophy? Some managers lose interest. The player starts getting fewer minutes. Suddenly, there are transfer rumors.
Then comes the breakup. Official statement: we have mutually agreed to terminate the contract. But somehow, the player is still on loan and available for friendly matches.
And just when you think the transfer window is closed... the former club sends a late-night offer. Can we talk? The player is suddenly back in negotiations.
At this point, forget the Premier League, forget Champions League... this is clearly a situationship with football terminology.
And somehow... this is not a football conversation.
